    for i in range(n-1):

            a = i*radial+j; b = i*radial+(j+1)%radial; c = (i+1)*radial+(j+1)%radial; d = (i+1)*radial+j

    for j in range(radial): faces.append((j, (j+1)%radial, base_idx))
    verts.append(tuple(pts[-1] + tangents[-1]*r1*0.5)); tip_idx = len(verts)-1
    last = (n-1)*radial
    for j in range(radial): faces.append((last+(j+1)%radial, last+j, tip_idx))
    me = bpy.data.meshes.new(name)
    me.from_pydata(verts, [], faces); me.update()
    o = bpy.data.objects.new(name, me)
    bpy.context.collection.objects.link(o)
    finish(o, material, smooth=True)
    if suckers:
        idx = 0
        for i in range(4, n-3, 4):
            t = i/(n-1); r = r0*(1-t)+r1*t
            if r < 0.045: continue
            for side in (-0.45, 0.45):
                d = (-normals[i]*0.85 + binormals[i]*side).normalized()
                pos = pts[i] + d*r*0.88

                so.rotation_euler = d.to_track_quat('Z','Y').to_euler()
                bpy.ops.object.transform_apply(scale=True, rotation=False, location=False)
                finish(so, sucker_mat or material, smooth=True)
